description: 3-loop crossed-box light-by-light (massive perimeter, massless diagonals). Top-sector maximal cut proven genus 0 by loop-by-loop localization: each massive sub-loop contributes only sqrt(quadratic), no irreducible quartic anywhere. Route A.
